GlobalPolicy.module-level-focus: Check mandatory document structure, stable anchors, and local references close to the changed artifact.
GlobalPolicy.wave-level-focus: Prove strict validation and atomic synchronization across 8-10 accepted task cards, thematic catalog tables, knowledge graph, evidence, and mentor acceptance.
GlobalPolicy.phase-level-focus: Validate all GRACE XML, catalog projection integrity, controlled vocabulary use, and GitHub rendering when shared Markdown structure changes.
GlobalPolicy.autonomy-gate: Every module requires executable or manual checks, observable artifact evidence, stop conditions, and wave or phase follow-up before autonomous edits.
GlobalPolicy.mentor-review-gate: Strict agent validation never replaces mentor wave acceptance; the mentor may spot-check individual cards.
GlobalPolicy.redaction: Never include secrets, credentials, private student data, or proprietary source material in repository content or evidence.

VF-001.NAME: StudentStudiesTask
VF-001.scenario: A student selects a suitable task and controls theory, hint, and solution disclosure on GitHub.
VF-001.expected-outcome: The catalog link works, metadata matches, required prompt content is visible, and every guidance block is independently collapsed.

required-signals.artifact-marker: README.md catalog row and relative task link
task metadata table and required headings
required-signals.trace-sequence: CATALOG_SELECTED -> TASK_OPENED -> THEORY_OPTIONAL -> HINT_N_OPTIONAL -> SOLUTION_OPTIONAL -> SELF_CHECK

VF-002.NAME: AgentAddsTask
VF-002.scenario: An AI agent adds one task from a mentor request.
VF-002.expected-outcome: An accepted task card, catalog projection, graph entry, and hybrid verification evidence change atomically, followed by mentor wave acceptance.

required-signals.trace-sequence: CONTRACT_READ -> METADATA_RESOLVED -> CANDIDATE_VALIDATED -> TASK_WRITTEN -> CATALOG_SYNCED -> GRAPH_SYNCED -> CHECKED -> WAVE_ACCEPTED

VF-003.NAME: AgentUpdatesTask
VF-003.scenario: An AI agent changes task content or metadata without leaving stale derived references.
VF-003.expected-outcome: Catalog placement, graph facts, prerequisites, assets, and inbound links remain consistent; ambiguous edits stop before drift is introduced.

VF-004.NAME: AgentValidatesCandidate
VF-004.scenario: An agent evaluates a candidate before publication and later publishes accepted cards as one wave.
VF-004.expected-outcome: Every stable ID in the frozen candidate register receives accepted, needs-rewrite, rejected, or duplicate with evidence; only accepted enters tasks/, and the wave remains open until mentor acceptance.

required-signals.artifact-marker: Beads validation decision and evidence type
accepted card or neutral non-publication reason
required-signals.trace-sequence: IDENTITY -> LEARNING_VALUE -> CONTRACT -> LOCAL_COMPLETENESS -> EXAMPLES -> SOLUTION -> VERIFICATION -> EDITORIAL -> DECISION -> WAVE_ACCEPTANCE

module-checks.check-2: Search for unresolved template placeholders and placeholder IDs.
module-checks.check-3: Cross-check every M-*, V-M-*, DF-*, VF-*, UC-*, Phase-*, and Gate-Phase-* reference.
module-checks.check-4: Verify that every accepted task slug has exactly one export-<task-slug> annotation under M-TASK-LIBRARY.
module-checks.check-5: Verify that AGENTS.md forbids direct commits and pushes to main, requires fetch plus isolated worktree creation from current origin/main, keeps one feature/<story-id> branch per story, and that .gitignore excludes .worktrees/ without excluding written specifications.
module-checks.check-6: Verify that AGENTS.md and .agents/skills/grace-cli/SKILL.md define the same PATH-then-$HOME/.bun/bin/grace resolution order; resolve GRACE_BIN, verify it is executable, and run "$GRACE_BIN" lint --fail-on errors --path "$PWD".

scenarios.scenario-1: All planning artifacts parse and every shared reference resolves consistently.
scenarios.scenario-2: A missing verification ref, contradictory contract, or invalid XML blocks completion.
scenarios.scenario-3: A non-interactive shell omits grace from PATH, GRACE_BIN resolves to $HOME/.bun/bin/grace, and the standard lint completes without issues.
scenarios.scenario-4: Neither PATH nor $HOME/.bun/bin/grace provides an executable CLI, so the agent reports the missing tool and uses the documented direct-inspection fallback.

required-trace-assertions.assertion-1: No implementation phase begins while a blocking shared-artifact contradiction remains.

V-M-GOVERNANCE.wave-follow-up: Apply task-wave graph and verification deltas through the controller-owned artifacts.
V-M-GOVERNANCE.phase-follow-up: Run the full XML and cross-reference audit.

module-checks.check-1: Verify exact mandatory metadata labels: Технологии, Тема, Формат, Уровень, Время, Навыки, Предварительные знания, and Среда выполнения.
module-checks.check-2: Verify controlled formats Реализация, Отладка, Разбор, Прогноз вывода and levels Базовый, Средний, Продвинутый.
module-checks.check-3: Verify visible goal, prompt, inputs or analysis questions, constraints, starter-code guidance, examples, readiness criteria, self-check, and optional targeted additional materials.
module-checks.check-4: Verify separate closed details blocks for theory, each hint, and the solution; reject the open attribute.
module-checks.check-5: Review the rendered GitHub view whenever the template or its HTML structure changes.

scenarios.scenario-1: The template renders compactly and allows theory, one hint at a time, and the solution to be opened independently.
scenarios.scenario-2: Missing metadata, combined hints, an open details block, or malformed nested Markdown blocks completion.

required-trace-assertions.assertion-1: The initial rendered page must not expose theory, hint bodies, or solution content.

V-M-TASK-TEMPLATE.wave-follow-up: Use the current template contract for every added task.
V-M-TASK-TEMPLATE.phase-follow-up: Sample the GitHub-rendered template and first conforming task.

module-checks.check-1: Apply identity, learning-value, contract, local-completeness, examples, solution, verification, and editorial gates in order.
module-checks.check-2: Freeze a finite Beads candidate register with stable IDs, then verify every candidate decision is accepted, needs-rewrite, rejected, or duplicate with a concise reason and evidence type.
module-checks.check-3: Run JavaScript, type-check TypeScript, exercise React or DOM in a temporary harness, use browser evidence for UI, or compare a written trace with actual output as appropriate.
module-checks.check-4: Verify external materials are targeted and reachable directly or through a valid redirect while prompt, starter code, fixtures, and solution remain local; required reading must not require a paid subscription or closed account.
module-checks.check-5: Reject publication when mandatory browser evidence is unavailable; record BLOCKED rather than PASS.

scenarios.scenario-1: An independently authored candidate has a unique learning goal, explicit environment, correct examples and solution, and matching hybrid evidence, so it becomes accepted.
scenarios.scenario-2: An ambiguous, duplicated, incorrect, externally incomplete, or unverifiable candidate cannot enter tasks/.

required-evidence-anchors.marker-5: candidate register size and stable candidate ID

required-trace-assertions.assertion-2: Temporary harnesses do not introduce permanent repository runtime tooling.

V-M-TASK-VALIDATION.wave-follow-up: Group 8-10 accepted cards, or 1-7 in the final incomplete wave; commit and push the technically passing wave, publish the validation report, and keep the child Beads issue open until mentor acceptance.
V-M-TASK-VALIDATION.phase-follow-up: Prove terminal-decision count equals frozen candidate-register size and no needs-rewrite remains at story completion.

module-checks.check-1: Enumerate task cards and verify each conforms to the current template contract.
module-checks.check-2: Resolve every prerequisite and asset link against the repository filesystem and verify every supplementary external link is reachable.
module-checks.check-3: Verify controlled metadata vocabulary, stable slug, local prompt and solution completeness, incremental hints, and task-specific environment assumptions.
module-checks.check-4: Verify an accepted validation decision and record mentor wave acceptance before closing the child issue.

scenarios.scenario-1: A student can understand and attempt the task using only the GitHub-rendered card.
scenarios.scenario-2: A non-accepted decision, missing prerequisite or asset, broken required or supplementary link, undeclared environment dependency, ambiguous classification, or unaccepted wave blocks completion.

required-evidence-anchors.marker-3: validation decision and mentor wave-acceptance status

required-trace-assertions.assertion-1: A task edit must not complete before dependent catalog and graph updates are verified.

V-M-TASK-LIBRARY.wave-follow-up: Compare changed task metadata with its catalog projection and graph delta.
V-M-TASK-LIBRARY.phase-follow-up: Review vocabulary consistency and sample student-facing task rendering.

module-checks.check-1: Enumerate all task cards and prove that each stable slug appears exactly once in the catalog.
module-checks.check-2: Resolve every catalog link and compare projected metadata with the canonical task metadata.
module-checks.check-3: Verify thematic tables, exactly one row per task across all themes, all catalog metadata columns, controlled topic names, level-then-name ordering, and an explicit empty state before the first task exists.

scenarios.scenario-1: A student can choose and open a task using compact, accurate metadata.
scenarios.scenario-2: A missing, duplicate, broken, or misclassified catalog entry blocks completion.

required-trace-assertions.assertion-1: Catalog synchronization must use task metadata as source of truth and must not silently rewrite the task to match a stale catalog row.

V-M-CATALOG.phase-follow-up: Review catalog usability and controlled vocabulary consistency.

required-evidence.evidence-1: All mandatory metadata and document anchors exist.
required-evidence.evidence-2: Theory, hints, and solution are independently collapsed by default.
required-evidence.evidence-3: Only accepted can produce an AcceptedTaskCard and every other decision remains unpublished.

commands.command-1: Freeze the Beads candidate register, run V-M-TASK-VALIDATION for every stable candidate ID, and group accepted cards into waves of 8-10 with a final-wave exception of 1-7.

commands.command-1: Run V-M-TASK-VALIDATION, V-M-TASK-LIBRARY, V-M-CATALOG, and V-M-GOVERNANCE.

required-evidence.evidence-3: Mentor wave acceptance is recorded before the child Beads issue is closed.

Gate-Phase-6.goal: The complete initial library has no unresolved candidate, validation, catalog, graph, link, acceptance, or Git-divergence defect.

commands.command-1: Run every module verification and the full GRACE, Markdown, link, catalog-projection, and Beads-status audit.
commands.command-2: Fetch origin and report branch divergence from origin/main without rewriting published history.

required-evidence.evidence-1: No needs-rewrite remains and terminal-decision count equals frozen candidate-register size.

commands.command-1: Review task count, catalog drift incidents, vocabulary conflicts, and repeated manual verification cost.

packet-template.expected-fields: scenario, contract-ref, expected-evidence, observed-evidence, first-divergent-artifact-or-anchor, next-action
packet-template.stop-conditions: ambiguous metadata or environment; duplicate learning goal; missing prerequisite or asset; broken supplementary link; unexpected GitHub rendering; catalog drift; unresolved inbound link; unavailable mandatory evidence; unaccepted wave
